<span class="hl-kw">&lt;?php</span>

<span class="hl-kw">declare</span>(<span class="hl-kw">strict_types</span>=<span class="hl-num">1</span>);

<span class="hl-kw">namespace</span> Flowcatalyst\Events\Platform\Iam\User;

<span class="hl-kw">final</span> <span class="hl-kw">readonly</span> <span class="hl-kw">class</span> UserLoggedInData
{
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> __construct(
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$email</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$federatedClaims</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$flowcatalystClaims</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$identityProviderCode</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$loginMethod</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$userId</span>,
    ) {}

    <span class="hl-comment">/** @param array&lt;string, mixed&gt; $data */</span>
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">static</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> fromArray(<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$data</span>): <span class="hl-kw">self</span>
    {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">new</span> <span class="hl-kw">self</span>(
            email: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'email'</span>],
            federatedClaims: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'federatedClaims'</span>],
            flowcatalystClaims: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'flowcatalystClaims'</span>],
            identityProviderCode: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'identityProviderCode'</span>],
            loginMethod: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'loginMethod'</span>],
            userId: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'userId'</span>],
        );
    }

    <span class="hl-comment">/** @return array&lt;string, mixed&gt; */</span>
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> toArray(): <span class="hl-kw">array</span>
    {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> [
            <span class="hl-str">'email'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;email,
            <span class="hl-str">'federatedClaims'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;federatedClaims,
            <span class="hl-str">'flowcatalystClaims'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;flowcatalystClaims,
            <span class="hl-str">'identityProviderCode'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;identityProviderCode,
            <span class="hl-str">'loginMethod'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;loginMethod,
            <span class="hl-str">'userId'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;userId,
        ];
    }
}
